title: Second moment of a sign linear form
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}$ be a real coefficient vector. For a uniformly distributed point $x$ of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the expected square of the linear form $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i x_i$ is $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a_i^2$.
